Luke Humphries's hopeful of playing in Players Championship after suffering shoulder injury
Luke Humphries hopes to be fit to play at this week's Players Championship Finals; you can watch the World Darts Championship live on Sky Sports from December 11
Tuesday 24 November 2026 17:38, UK
Luke Humphries is hopeful of playing in this week's Players Championship, Sky Sports News understands.
Humphries appeared to struggle with a shoulder injury during his shock last-16 defeat to Tom Sykes at last week's Grand Slam of Darts and was seen wincing in pain during the match.
The former world champion took to social media after the contest to congratulate Sykes and admitted he had been through a tough 48 hours.

"Well done Tom Sykes, absolutely amazing performance!" wrote Humphries.
"So proud of the way I played tonight with what I've had to go through with injury the last 48 hours. Gave it my absolute all there."
Humphries is due to open his Players Championship campaign against Darryl Pilgrim on Friday night in Minehead.
The World Darts Championship starts on Friday, December 11.
